Election Summary
* Total Registration (Active + Inactive voters) 262,877 Mail Ballots: 184,569
* Active Registered Voters 235,603 In-Person Ballots: 14,317
* Property Owner Only Ballots Distributed 488 Property Owner Ballots: 433
Total Ballots Counted: 199,319
* Voter Registration Figures as of 7 p.m. Nov. 5
12/5 Update: The recounts for State Representative – District 19 (required recount), Town of Superior Trustee (required recount), and Town of Erie Council District 1 (paid recount) – have been completed and the results certified.
The vote totals below show updated official results and are final.
Note: For voter anonymity purposes, precincts with fewer than 10 registered voters have been suppressed from this turnout page.
